business_problem: However, their existing data environment was poorly suited to efficiently manage such massive data volumes.
solution_summary: As the world’s first mobile navigation service, TMAP Mobility has established themself as an industry leader over the past 20 years by providing the fastest and safest routes possible. With over 25 million subscribers and adoption in more than 95% of domestic vehicles in Korea, TMAP handles more than 7.3 billion mobility data points annually, delivering personalized travel experiences at scale. However, their existing data environment was poorly suited to efficiently manage such massive data volumes. Teams were hindered by limited data access and rigid security controls, which made it difficult to accelerate AI-driven recommendation efforts. Aiming for data democratization and enhanced governance, TMAP adopted the Databricks Data + AI Platform and successfully established a new data environment to support their future growth.
business_outcome: TMAP Mobility achieved measurable business impact on Databricks, including 68% Reduction in repetitive data requests for the analytics team; 48% Of employees can now directly access and use data; As the world’s first mobile navigation service, TMAP Mobility has established themself as an industry leader over the past 20 years by providing the fastest and safest routes possible..
